page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Enhanced family, hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8475B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz, delivering 24 dedicated virtual CPU cores. The instance is provisioned with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a uniform 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

The system does not bundle local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of remote block volumes for persistent data management. Networking capabilities include a baseline throughput of 15 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses supplied by default. The configuration lacks GPU hardware acceleration, focusing strictly on CPU-bound and memory-balanced enterprise operations.

From an efficiency standpoint, the provision of dedicated Intel vCPUs eliminates the performance unpredictability found in shared-core models. The lack of integrated NVMe drives trades localized low-latency IOPS for the persistence flexibility of cloud storage. These characteristics make ecs.g8ise.6xlarge suitable for distributed application tiers, container orchestration nodes, relational database hosting, and continuous integration pipelines.
